Conference Speakers

Meet the innovators, thought leaders, and industry experts shaping the future of technology.

Dr. Sarah Chen

Chief Technology Officer

CloudScale Inc.

Topic: AI-Driven Infrastructure

View Full Bio

Dr. Sarah Chen leads CloudScale's technology vision with 15 years of experience in distributed systems and cloud infrastructure. She has published 20+ papers on scalable computing and is a frequent keynote speaker at major tech conferences.

Marcus Rodriguez

VP of Product

NeuralFlow

Topic: Machine Learning in Production

View Full Bio

Marcus has built and shipped machine learning products used by millions of users worldwide. At NeuralFlow, he oversees product strategy across computer vision, NLP, and recommendation systems, bridging the gap between research and real-world applications.

Emma Thompson

Founder & CEO

SecureVault

Topic: Zero-Trust Security

View Full Bio

Emma founded SecureVault after 10 years at leading cybersecurity firms. Her company now protects Fortune 500 enterprises with innovative zero-trust architecture. She's an active advisor to governments on digital security policy.

James Park

Principal Engineer

DataMind

Topic: Real-Time Analytics at Scale

View Full Bio

James has architected data pipelines processing petabytes daily. He's a core contributor to open-source analytics projects and passionate about making data infrastructure accessible to all teams, regardless of scale.

Dr. Amelia Wright

Director of Research

QuantumLeap Labs

Topic: Quantum Computing Breakthroughs

View Full Bio

Dr. Wright's research in quantum algorithms has garnered international recognition. She leads a team exploring practical quantum applications for optimization and simulation, bridging academia and industry at QuantumLeap Labs.

David Kim

Chief Product Officer

VisionAI

Topic: Computer Vision in Healthcare

View Full Bio

David pioneered the use of computer vision in diagnostic imaging. Under his leadership, VisionAI's AI system has been deployed in over 300 hospitals, assisting radiologists in detecting diseases with unprecedented accuracy.

Rachel Goldstein

Engineering Lead

CodeStream

Topic: Building Developer Platforms

View Full Bio

Rachel has spent 12 years building tools that delight developers. At CodeStream, she leads the platform team creating infrastructure for the next generation of collaborative development environments.

Michael Torres

Head of Innovation

EcoTech

Topic: Sustainable Technology

View Full Bio

Michael combines technology with environmental responsibility. At EcoTech, he leads initiatives to reduce carbon footprints through innovative software solutions and advocates for sustainability in the tech industry.

Dr. Lisa Chen

Senior Researcher

AI Ethics Institute

Topic: Responsible AI Development

View Full Bio

Dr. Chen leads groundbreaking research on AI bias, fairness, and transparency. Her work shapes policy and best practices worldwide, ensuring AI systems benefit everyone and reflect diverse human values.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I change my ticket tier after purchase?

Yes, you can upgrade your ticket up to 7 days before the conference. Contact us at tickets@techvision2024.com for assistance.

Is there a group discount?

Groups of 10 or more receive a 15% discount on any ticket tier. Please contact us directly for group registration.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers. All transactions are encrypted and secure.

Is there a refund policy?

Full refunds are available up to 30 days before the conference. Refunds requested between 30 and 14 days before the event will incur a 20% processing fee.

Do students or employees receive discounts?

Yes! Students with valid ID and employees of participating tech companies receive a 10% discount. Verify your status at checkout.

What's included in the conference materials?

All attendees receive a conference badge, agenda booklet, notepad, and pen. VIP Pass holders also receive an exclusive gift bag with premium items and speaker bios.
